sets.title: Law and method changes
sets.what: Changes since 2016 that break year-to-year comparisons.
rows: HB 300 (2025, effective 5/7/2025): a mailed ballot must be RECEIVED by the election officer by 8 p.m. on Election Day (postmark grace removed); voter must write the last four digits of driver license/state ID (or SSN) on the return envelope; signature comparison allowed only until 2029; from 2029 a ballot is mailed only to voters who request one (request lasts 8 years)

BREAK for 2026: in 2018-2024 ballots postmarked the day before ED and arriving later were counted (EAC 2024 postmark date 11/04/2024); 2026 'outstanding' mail that arrives after ED will not count; envelope-ID errors are a new rejection reason; mail stays universal in 2026
EAC Policy Survey 2024: all-mail; same-day registration yes; cure deadline 11/15/2024; postmark deadline 11/04/2024 (day before ED); in-person early voting 10/22/2024-11/01/2024
